comments.author: RogueTech67
comments.body_html:
PaPaSamBuBu, Thanks for adding to our option of mods to use. Couple of questions.

1) May we assume that if we load the mod, that all the values of the items listed in mods.ts are the game’s “default” values? Meaning if we load the mod and do nothing, we have not effected the game?

2) Appears you chose to add all categories under “Loot” [ https://escapefromtarkov.fandom.com/wiki/Loot ] up to but excluding the last category “Special equipment”. Just curious, was there a reason this one was left out, and do you know or feel it’s safe for us to add it and the (11) items in?

Thanks in advance.

comments.author: PaPaSamBuBu
comments.body_html:
I assume nothing bad will happen if you add them, it was just getting late and I’ve never modified those items before so I didn’t bother. Like I said, I used this for myself but if you’d like me to add them I could.

As for your first question, yes it should be all the default values so that people can change what they want and not have to worry about changes they don’t want. If I’ve made any mistakes please notify me and I’ll fix them when I make an update.

I’ve got one question for you, would you like to see this same sort of thing done with guns, armors ect? obviously I’d add a lot more values that you can mess around with like ergo, velocity ect. Just trying to see if anyone wants this or not so I don’t waste a month on it lol

comments.author: RogueTech67
comments.body_html: PaPaSamBuBu, Thanks for the response. Yes, I personally would like to see this expanded to weapons and armor.

comments.body_html: Mags are actually next to be added, will probably be updated in a few days cause making this takes awhile.

comments.author: Tasktale

comments.author: Oraceon
comments.body_html: Are these values handled by the server? I want to use this on my Fika server, but I needed to know if everybody should download this and use the same config or if only the host needs the mod. Thank you.

comments.author: PaPaSamBuBu
comments.body_html: Changes values on the server side so I assume only the host would need it installed, I don’t use Fika though so not 100% sure.

comments.author: Oraceon
comments.body_html: Thank you for the swift reply. It seems to work fine with only the host using the mod so far.
